title: Sicily vs Sardinia: Which Italian Island Should You Visit?
verdict: Sicily for culture, food, and budget. Sardinia for beaches. Sicily is 30-50% cheaper.

categories.name: Beach Quality
categories.summary: Sardinia wins with Caribbean-clear water at Costa Smeralda and the Gulf of Orosei.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Sicilian cuisine is one of the most celebrated in Italy - street food, Arab-Norman fusion, fresh seafood.

categories.name: Historical Sites
categories.summary: Valley of Temples, Arab-Norman churches, Roman mosaics, and Mount Etna.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Sicily 60-90 EUR/day; Sardinia 90-130 EUR/day. Costa Smeralda in August can reach 250+ EUR/day.

categories.name: City Life
categories.summary: Palermo, Catania, Syracuse, and Taormina all offer genuine urban character.

categories.name: Nature & Outdoors
categories.summary: Sicily has Etna and Aeolian Islands; Sardinia has Supramonte mountains and dramatic coastline.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Both well-served by budget airlines; Sicily also accessible by ferry from Naples.

categories.name: Best Time
categories.summary: Sicily works year-round; Sardinia is primarily a summer beach destination.

categories.name: Authenticity
categories.summary: Sicily feels genuinely Sicilian everywhere; Sardinia's coast can feel touristy/luxury.

faq.question: Is Sicily or Sardinia better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Sicily - more variety, better value, and 3,000 years of history.

faq.question: Which has better beaches?
faq.answer: Sardinia wins beaches; Costa Smeralda and Gulf of Orosei are among Europe's best.

faq.question: Which is cheaper?
faq.answer: Sicily is 30-50% cheaper than Sardinia, especially in peak August.
